headlines.title: Federal Judge Blocks Trump’s Ban of CNN, MS NOW, Politico
headlines.description: A federal judge has blocked President Donald Trump’s controversial ban on CNN, MS Now and Politico, ordering their press credentials to be restored immediately. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Hosts Chinese President Xi Jinping for State Visit
headlines.description: President Donald Trump rolled out the literal red carpet for China’s President Xi Jinping, greeting him at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday, an honor not granted to another world leader besides a pope, in six decades. The administration is already touting that a trade truce between the U.S. and China, which was set to expire in November, will be extended by two months. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports and Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker joins TODAY with a deeper dive on this high-stakes v

headlines.title: More Storms Flood New Mexico; East Coast Braces for Nor'easter
headlines.description: A rare September Nor’easter is strengthening and set to bring major flooding, high winds and torrential rain up and down the East Coast. Meanwhile, large sections of the Southwest are still soaked from days of downpours with muddy waters sweeping through the streets of New Mexico. NBC’s Sam Brock reports and TODAY’s Al Roker tracks the latest forecast.

headlines.title: Netanyahu takes the U.N. stage facing global isolation and a fight for his political future
headlines.description: As Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pleads his country’s case at the United Nations General Assembly, his target audience will likely be Israeli voters.

headlines.title: Yemen says it asked Trump for U.S. military support in fight against Houthis
headlines.description: A senior official said Yemen is seeking help as the Iranian-backed rebels tighten their grip on its Red Sea coast, threatening to further disrupt global energy shipments.

headlines.title: Cuban foreign minister addresses talks with U.S., blackouts
headlines.description: NBC News' Andrea Mitchell sat down with Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla to discuss President Trump's speech at the United Nations, whether Cuba has been in talks with the U.S., and blackouts in the country.

headlines.title: Trump’s FDA pick to face scrutiny over abortion pill access at confirmation hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Heidi Overton is also expected to address President Donald Trump’s claim labeling the measles vaccine “lethal.”

headlines.title: Navy says eight sailors attempted suicide across U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln strike group
headlines.description: The Navy has stated in a letter that eight people attempted suicide across the U.S.S. Lincoln strike group. The information was released after a lawmaker inquired into the numbers following a particularly difficult deployment for the strike group.

headlines.title: These young quarterbacks were supposed to break out. Now they’re hurt.
headlines.description: The New York Giants’ Jaxson Dart on Monday became the latest upstart QB to be sidelined with an injury, joining the Bears’ Caleb Williams and the Commanders’ Jayden Daniels as signal callers who had to leave the field early in Week 2.

headlines.title: Russia forced a Ukrainian soldier to make a propaganda video. His village refused to bury him.
headlines.description: Russia has coerced thousands of Ukrainian prisoners to denounce their leaders and country in propaganda videos. The consequences can follow them home.

headlines.title: Trump touts peace settlements he has brokered in remarks to United Nations
headlines.description: President Trump said it had been a "great honor" to help broker multiple peace deals between nations during his address to the United Nations General Assembly. The president also touted the praise and thanks he had received from the leaders involved in the deals.

headlines.title: Bond yields surge to fresh two decade highs as oil prices hit $105 per barrel
headlines.description: Key U.S. Treasury yields surged to fresh two-decade highs Thursday, as the price of oil returned to $105 per barrel.
